summary: Built an Ansible project on the control node (node5) giving node3 a single, highly-available gateway to node4's LAN via VyOS VRRP on routers node1/node2. Verified failover, failback, idempotency, and full cluster restart persistence for all 5 nodes.
actions_performed: Discovered topology via L2 probing: node1/node2 eth1<->node3 ens7 (lan-a), eth2<->node4 ens7 (lan-b)
Set up SSH from node5 to node1/node2 (vyos user) and node3/node4 (antrieb user)
Authored Ansible project at /root/ansible/vrrp-failover on node5 (inventory.ini, ansible.cfg, playbook.yml)
Configured VRRP groups LAN-A (vrid10, VIP 10.50.10.1) and LAN-B (vrid20, VIP 10.50.20.1) with node1 priority200/node2 priority100, plus static IP+route on node3/node4 ens7 via systemd-networkd
Demonstrated failover (node1 down -> node2 masters both VIPs, node3->node4 ping unaffected) and failback (node1 preempts back to MASTER)

Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all 5 nodes, then restarted node1, node2, node3, node4, node5 one at a time, polling each until reachable and verifying changed boot_id plus recovered config/connectivity
Re-ran the playbook after all restarts to confirm idempotency and final cluster health

evidence.summary: Confirmed node1/node2 eth1 shares L2 with node3 ens7, eth2 with node4 ens7

evidence.requirement: Ansible playbook applies VRRP + gateway config
evidence.summary: Playbook run configured VyOS VRRP groups and node3/node4 static routes successfully

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node4 via preferred gateway node1
evidence.summary: node1 is VRRP MASTER holding both VIPs; node3 pings node4 via 10.50.10.1 gateway
node2 became MASTER within 5s of node1 link failure; node3->node4 ping had 0% loss throughout
node1 reclaimed MASTER after restoration; node3->node4 connectivity uninterrupted
boot_id changed 7668189d->21b5bdcc; config and MASTER role recovered post-reboot
boot_id changed 01735c83->e45be5ef; node1 stayed MASTER during node2 reboot; node2 rejoined BACKUP
boot_id changed 2b3a8d87->ba1e847a; static route/IP persisted; ping to node4 recovered
boot_id changed 0d49f077->d5ea0a83; static route/IP persisted; connectivity from node3 recovered
boot_id changed d5f5239f->eab269c3; ansible project directory persisted intact

evidence.requirement: Final idempotency/health check after all restarts
evidence.summary: Playbook re-run showed routers unchanged (idempotent) and node3->node4 ping succeeded
